name: MF50201V1-1B00U-A99
description: The Sunon MF50201V1-1B00U-A99 is a 50×20mm radial blower fan with Vapo bearing technology. Its 20mm depth provides more airflow than the 5015 variant, and it is used in 3D printers where a higher-volume blower is needed for part cooling or duct designs that can accommodate the extra thickness.
